app.name: SplitDebt
app.tagline: Track group spending, split bills and settle debts.

auth.heroTitle:
Share the fun.
Let SplitDebt do the math.
auth.heroSubtitle: Log expenses in seconds, split equally, by amount or by percentage — and always know who pays whom.
auth.heroPoint1Desc: Every expense links payer, group and date — clear, no more notebooks.
auth.heroPoint2Desc: Equal, exact amounts or percentages — ±1 rounding gaps handled automatically.
auth.heroPoint3Desc: Suggests the fewest transfers to settle the whole group.
auth.heroProof: Trusted by friend groups, classes and company teams
